aboutUs.title: About Us
paragraphs: DapurHPP was born from real experience seeing fried food SMEs struggle to accurately calculate capital, COGS, and profits. Many still record manually on paper, unsure about fluctuating ingredient prices, and unaware whether their business is profitable or not.
We are here as a simple, automatic, and trusted digital solution. With DapurHPP, food business owners can focus on cooking and serving customers — let us handle the numbers.

guides.title: Usage Guide
steps: Create a new account on the Registration page, then sign in.
Add raw materials with their prices in the Materials menu.
Create your recipes in the Recipes menu — COGS will be calculated automatically.
Record material purchases in the Purchases menu to update current prices.
Enter daily production and sales data to view profit and loss reports.

items.q: Can DapurHPP be used for businesses other than fried food?
items.a: Yes, the COGS calculation logic applies to various types of food, but the initial features are focused on fried food businesses.

items.q: How do I reset my password if I forget it?
items.a: Click 'Forgot Password?' on the login page, enter your registered email, and follow the reset link sent to your email.

items.q: Is my recipe and financial data secure?
items.a: Yes. All data is encrypted and only accessible by your account. We do not sell or share data with third parties.

items.q: Can I export reports to Excel/PDF?
items.a: The export feature is under development and will be available in a future update.

sections.title: 1. Information We Collect
sections.body: DapurHPP collects data you consciously enter for your culinary business calculation purposes, which includes:
items: Account Information: Full Name, Email Address, Password (encrypted with Bcrypt), and Your Culinary Business Name.
Kitchen Operational Data: List of Raw Materials, Suppliers, Recipe Formulas, Purchase Costs, Production Data, Selling Price Snapshots, and Other Expense History.

sections.title: 2. Use of Your Information
sections.body: All operational data you enter into the system is processed solely to provide accurate financial visualizations for yourself, including:
items: Dynamically calculating COGS for fried food in real-time based on the latest purchases.
Presenting profit summary charts, accumulated losses, and periodic sales performance on your dashboard.
Validating data ownership (JWT Identity Verification Check) so other users cannot view your kitchen recipes.

sections.title: 3. Financial Information Security
sections.body: We implement industry-standard security protocols using JWT Token Ownership with Guard-based NestJS to keep API endpoints secure from external manipulation. Your password is protected using one-way hashing salt, making it impossible to read manually even by DapurHPP administrators.

sections.title: 4. Your SME Data Access Rights
sections.body: As a business owner, you have full control over your own data. You can add, modify recipes, or delete operational records (including soft-delete mechanisms on master raw materials to avoid breaking historical transaction calculations).

terms.title: Terms & Conditions
terms.intro: Welcome to DapurHPP. By registering, accessing, or using our platform, you agree to comply with all terms and conditions set forth below.

sections.title: 1. Account Registration Terms
sections.body: This service is specifically designed to simplify managerial calculations for culinary SMEs. You are required to:
items: Provide an active and valid email address for JWT authentication purposes.
Maintain the confidentiality of your password credentials to prevent unauthorized access.
One account is recommended for one culinary business entity to preserve accurate net profit calculations.

sections.title: 2. Accuracy of COGS & Financial Figures
sections.body: The DapurHPP system calculates Cost of Goods Sold (COGS) automatically based on dynamic mathematical formulas using your latest expense input variables.
sections.note: Important Note: Final profit/loss calculation accuracy depends heavily on user precision in recording real expenses and operational sales snapshots. DapurHPP provides calculation tools and is not liable for physical cash discrepancies due to transaction input errors or internal management oversight.

sections.title: 3. General Usage Restriction Policy
sections.body: Users are strictly prohibited from attempting exploitation, security vulnerability penetration (cyber attacks) on our NestJS API backend, corrupting MySQL database structures via SQL Injection, or forging JWT token payloads. Violations will result in permanent account suspension.

sections.title: 4. Service Changes & Policy Updates
sections.body: The DapurHPP platform is continuously developed to provide comprehensive financial performance reports. Therefore, these terms may be adjusted at any time without prior written notice and will take immediate effect upon publication.
